name: Illithid Harvester — "They're 2/2 Horror creatures" reaches only the targets
notes: Memory: project_im_a_doctor_pronoun_subject_2026-10-14. The fired trigger's 'They're' subject ran back over the previous sentence and made every creature a 2/2 Horror. A bare 'it / they' now takes the earlier 'target …' phrase, without its closing 'face down' (read as two required subtypes, which emptied the picker). The site offers a single-target picker for 'any number of target', so one target is set here.
